z-m-37-03.title: Uma uhlukanisa 'A−(B∪C)', iyisethi efanayo?
z-m-37-03.topic: Ukuhlola ukuthi ukulingana kwamasethi okuxubanisa umehluko nokuhlanganisa kusebenza yini
z-m-37-03.goal: Hlola ukuthi ukulingana kwesethi kulungile yini ngokucabangela amacala ayisishiyagalombili okuthi into eyodwa ingeyesethi noma cha, thola isisho esiphutha, bese ukhetha ezilungile.
z-m-37-03.material: U-Minjun uthi lokhu: 'Kumasethi A, B, C, A−(B∪C) = (A−B)∪(A−C) kuhlala kusebenza.' (A−B ifundwa 'umehluko ka-A kususwe B'.) Esikhundleni sesithombe, ufuna ukuhlola ngokuthi into eyodwa x ingeyika-A, B, C ngamunye (1 uma ingeyakhe, 0 uma ingeyakhe). Kunamacala angu-8, kusukela ku-(A, B, C) = (0,0,0) kuya ku-(1,1,1).

z-m-37-03.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi iqiniso lokuthi kunamacala angu-8 kuphela likusiza kanjani ngenani lokuhlola.
z-m-37-03.s.s1.o.a: Kwanele uma imiphumela yezisho ezimbili iyafana ecaleni elilodwa kuphela kwamacala angu-8
z-m-37-03.s.s1.r.a: Uzame ukusho 'njalo' kusukela ekuvumelaneni kwecala elilodwa. Kuthiwani ngamacala asele?
z-m-37-03.s.s1.o.b: Kwanele uma amasethi amabili efana kuphela ecaleni lapho u-x engeyena owa-B noma u-C
z-m-37-03.s.s1.r.b: Ulenze icala elilodwa elikhethekile limele wonke. Kwamanye amacala lingahluka.
z-m-37-03.s.s1.o.c: Kwanele uma amasethi amabili enenani elifanayo lezingxenye

z-m-37-03.s.s2.prompt: Yakha isimo sobulungu (A, B, C) lapho u-x owa-A−(B∪C) kodwa hhayi owa-(A−B)∪(A−C), noma okuphambene, okungukuthi, lapho imiphumela yezisho ezimbili ihlukile.

z-m-37-03.s.s2.explain: Uma (A,B,C)=(1,1,0), u-x owa-B, ngakho akewa-A−(B∪C), kodwa owa-A−C, ngakho owa-(A−B)∪(A−C). Kuyafana ku-(1,0,1). Ngakho lokhu kuhambisana akubambi.

z-m-37-04.topic: Ukukhetha izisho zesethi ezisho into efanayo ne-'A uyingxenye ka-B'
z-m-37-04.goal: Khetha izisho ezisho into efanayo no-A⊂B, futhi ubonise ngezibonelo ezincane kumacala amaphi izisho ezingasho into efanayo ziyehluleka.
